analysis.summary: Macpower CNC reported its highest-ever quarterly performance in Q2 FY27 in terms of revenue, EBITDA, and PAT, with revenue reaching INR 120.33 crores. Management raised its annual growth guidance for the current year to nearly 35% and stated that the order book stands at INR 476 crores. The company is expanding manufacturing capacity through a newly acquired 13-acre land parcel, expected to be operational by the end of Q2 FY28. Furthermore, management noted strong demand and improvements in working capital and average machine realizations. Macpower CNC reported record financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, achieving its highest-ever revenue, EBITDA, and PAT.

guidance.claim: Management increased the annual growth guidance for this year to nearly 35%.
guidance.quote: I think in last first quarter we committed 30% growth and I think we delivered that growth in quarter 2 and now I am increasing our guidance for this year growth is nearly 35%.

guidance.claim: The guidance for the coming three years is 25% to 30% growth.
guidance.quote: FY27 and FY28, I think we will continue our growth journey like 25% to 30%.

guidance.claim: Management expects operating and PAT margins to exceed 20% in the future.
guidance.quote: Definitely it will increase by, gradually it will increase, but definitely it will be more than 20%.

guidance.claim: Management is guiding for plus 35 percent revenue growth for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, with a strong order book of Rs. 476 crore, an expanding high-end product portfolio and ongoing capacity investments, we are confident of delivering another year of robust growth and are guiding for +35% revenue growth for the current financial year.

guidance.claim: The company confirmed a revenue growth guidance of over 30% for the coming year.
guidance.quote: Future guidance with the strong order book of INR456 crore, almost y-o-y 32% grown by last year to this year. And expanding high-end product portfolio and ongoing CapEx, we are - confirm our delivering another year of robust growth and are looking at plus 30%.

demand_outlook.quote: Pending order book as of Q2 stands at INR 476 crores, reflected 36% y-o-y growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Total bids in the pipeline stand at INR 939 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: Total bids in the pipeline INR 939 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Average machine realization increased to INR 20.36 lakh.
demand_outlook.quote: Average machine realization is also increased now. It's INR 20.36 lakh.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted robust operational execution and sustained demand momentum for high-precision CNC machines.
demand_outlook.quote: These results reflect robust operational execution, sustained demand momentum for our high-precision CNC machines, and disciplined progress on strategic initiatives.

demand_outlook.claim: The pending order book for the first quarter stands at INR456 crores, reflecting a 32% year-on-year growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Robust order book and strong demand in pipeline, pending order book of quarter one stands at INR456 crore, reflecting 32% y-o-y growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic bids submitted totaled INR739 crores, with tender bids under evaluation at INR304 crores and domestic quotations in the pipeline exceeding INR1,000 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic bid submitted INR739 crore. Tender bid under evolution INR304 crores and domestic quotations is in pipeline for INR1,000-plus crore INR1,043 crore.

capex_expansion.claim: CapEx during the quarter was INR 2.89 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: CapEx during the quarter was INR 2.89 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Development work in upcoming technical centres in Kolhapur, Mumbai, Chennai, and Aurangabad is underway and expected to be operational in the third quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: Development work in our upcoming 4 tech centres in Kolhapur, Mumbai, Chennai and Aurangabad is underway and we will expect to be operational in third quarter.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of new capacity on the 13-acre land at Chhapra has commenced and is expected to become operational by Q2 FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction of new capacity on the 13-acre land at Chhapra has commenced and is expected to become operational by Q2 FY28, enabling de-bottlenecking, backward integration and significant scaling.

capex_expansion.claim: The company selected 13 acres of land on a 30-year long-term lease near the existing plant for infrastructure expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: In line with our aggressive growth strategy and sustained momentum in order flow, we have selected 13 acres, 9 plus 4 for green zone of land on a 30 years long term, legally registered lease near our existing plant.

capex_expansion.claim: The estimated investment for the new expansion is INR50 crores with a targeted completion within 12 months.
capex_expansion.quote: Targeted completion of this facility within 12 months. Estimated investment of this expansion is INR50 crores.

margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR 19.94 crores with growth of 40.8% y-o-y with EBITDA margin of 16.6%.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 PAT stood at INR 13.47 crores with a PAT margin of 11.2%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT stood at INR 13.47 crores, grown 43.7% y-o-y with a PAT margin of 11.2%.

margins_costs.claim: Incremental CapEx has led to a corresponding increase in depreciation.
margins_costs.quote: Incremental CapEx has led to a corresponding increase in depreciation.

margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was Rs. 19.94 crore, growing 40.8% YoY with a healthy margin of 16.57%.

margins_costs.claim: Average machine realization remained healthy at around 20.36 lakh rupees.
margins_costs.quote: For H1 FY27, revenue reached Rs. 215.56 crore, up 46.9% YoY. Average machine realization remained healthy at around Rs. 20.36 lakh.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin stood at 16.20% and PAT margin stood at 10.06% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR15.43 crore, grown by 95% in y-o-y. And EBITDA margin of 16.20%, PAT stood at INR9.58 crore, grown by 110% y-o-y with the PAT margin of 10.06%.

margins_costs.claim: The company increased prices by 4% to 6%, effective from June 1st.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, definitely, we increased the price by 4% to 6% and this first quarter we had given chance, to our customer, who have given the order, that if you are not lifting the machine, you are to you are eligible to give us 4% to 6% new price increment.
